summary.purpose: P1 playtest item: 離間 ("在至多3位玩家棄牌堆各放入1張內鬥") was structured as count:3 with no target, and add_internal_conflict's no-target fallback placed all three 內鬥 into the CASTER's own discard pile — the reported red-army bug. The card is now target_scope:"others"/max_targets:3/count:1-each, the fallback to the caster is removed (logged no-op instead), and the supply-consumption fix from C1 applies. 情報網 option A shares the same path.
